On the border with France lies Germany's largest amusement park. With over 100 attractions and 14 roller coasters, it attracts more than 7 million visitors every year. Since its opening, over 150 million people have visited this park, and it has now been named the best amusement park in the world eleven times in a row. We spent two full days in this park and took in every attraction to find out if it truly lives up to its reputation or if it's completely overrated in the end.
